_comment: Copy to ~/.config/cortados/exec-hosts.json on EVERY machine that runs the cortados-route MCP server or receives tasks (the Air needs it too: it recognises itself by `hostnames`). `default` is the host new start_task calls run on (owner decision 2026-11-08: the always-on Air). An entry reached over ssh needs `router` (its cortados-router checkout) and should set `claude`, `path` (ssh sessions get a bare PATH) and `provider_url` (its own provider; the token is read from ~/.config/cortados/provider-token THERE). `gui: true` means chrome (login-mode) children are launched as per-task LaunchAgents in the desktop session (ssh sessions cannot read the login Keychain). An entry without `ssh` is this machine; add `hostnames` so the same file works when the server runs on that host. Add the Studio as another entry when it is ready.
